newsitem.title: FRANCE: French minister sees 100,000 fewer jobless youth.
newsitem.headline: French minister sees 100,000 fewer jobless youth.

text.p: Social Affairs Minister Jacques Barrot said on Monday that there would be 100,000 fewer unemployed youths in France by the end of the year, compared with levels at the end of 1993.

"There is a trend which, if it holds up, will lead to 100,000 fewer young unemployed people compared to the end of 1993, which would be a welcome development," Barrot told reporters while attending a meeting of business leaders in Toulouse, southern France.
There were 750,000 unemployed young people at the end of 1993. It was unclear why Barrot chose to refer to a statistic more than three years old.
